title: Owning with unique_ptr
hints: `enemies.back().get()` gives a borrowed raw pointer to the enemy just added. To take one out, `std::move` the `unique_ptr` out of the vector before erasing its slot.
`std::erase_if(vector, predicate)` (C++20) removes every element the predicate accepts, and destroying a `unique_ptr` deletes its enemy.
